tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Flow-time estimate] 1. Equation 8.12.1\group harmonic functionsSource: thurston:page-0234 For a positive function $h$ and the flow generated by $-\operatorname {grad}h$, if $A$ is a finite-length portion of a flow line through $x$, then \[ T(A)=\int _A rac{1}{ orm {\operatorname {grad}h}}\, ds\geq rac{\length (A)^2}{\int _A orm {\operatorname {grad}h}\, ds}\geq rac{\length (A)^2}{h(x)}. \] The flow exists for all positive time.
